# shooosh

> WGSL-first site GPU engine. WebGPU when available, WebGL2 fallback. Documentation and tasks are written for coding agents.

Use the focused files below first. Read `llms-full` only when it exists. Do not ingest `node_modules/` or `dist/`.

## When to use shooosh

- A site needs a fullscreen shader, a page-behind layer, or DOM-tracked quads
- The authored shader language should be WGSL
- The same code must run on WebGPU or fall back to WebGL2
- An agent needs to implement or extend the engine without inventing a new scene API

## Public API (current)

Source: `package/index.ts` (file-level headers = how to use each module)

- `probeRenderer()` → `"webgpu" | "webgl2" | null`
- `createEngine` (async, `{ backend?: "auto"|"webgpu"|"webgl2" }`) / `initEngine` / `getDefaultEngine` / `setDefaultEngine` / `resolveEngine`
- `createScene` / `Scene` / `parseSceneDataset`
- `acquireLayer` / `releaseLayer`
- `createItem` / `createScreen` / `createObject` / `createParticles` / `createMsdfGlyphs`
- `effects` / `createPostProcessor`
- `loadTexture` / `loadGlb` / `createFakeHdriCanvas`
- `convertWgslFragmentToGlsl` / `convertGlslFragmentToWgsl` / `isGlsl300`
- `compileProgramAsync` — non-blocking WebGL compile
- `createMouseMonad` / `createMouseTrail`

Node / Bun only (`shooosh/msdf`, not the browser entry):

- `generateMsdf` / `generateFontAtlas` / `generateIconSdf` / `alphaToSdf`
- CLI: `pnpm msdf -- <inputs> --out <dir>` / `npx shooosh-msdf`

## Shader contract

See [docs/shader-contract.md](./docs/shader-contract.md). Short form:

- Author `shaders.fragment` as WGSL with `fn fsMain`.
- `vUv` is top-origin.
- Uniforms today: `setUni({ value1 })` → `uUni.values0.x` / `uUni[0].x` (16 floats). Named uniforms are task 03.
- Full `#version 300 es` GLSL is a WebGL2 escape hatch. Port it with `convertGlslFragmentToWgsl` (skill: `glsl-to-wgsl`).
- Failed compile must not blank the page.

## Machine interfaces (target)

These should exist after the matching tasks. Until then, this repo *is* the interface.

- `/agents.md` and `/llms.txt` on the hosted showcase (task 06)
- `shooosh check` CLI (task 05)
- Example gallery the harness can pull from (`examples/` is the source; harness wiring later)
